Summary: The exact match (EM) score for DRAGIN Llama2-13b on the HotpotQA benchmark is 0.314. This score represents the proportion of predictions that match the gold answer string exactly. The HotpotQA benchmark measures models' ability to perform multi-step reasoning over text, requiring the integration of discrete pieces of evidence. The EM metric quantifies this ability by assessing the exact string match against gold answers.
